en: Hand‑tinted historic postcard showing the entrance to an iron pedestrian bridge with ornate railings and a decorative arch topped by a large round clock. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand on or near the bridge. To the right is a timber‑framed building partly covered with ivy, and trees line the left side. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.
